text:
Four people, three of them children, were killed in Gaza when a sand embankment collapsed onto tents, the health ministry says.

It came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across the Strip.

Israel's ambassador to the US, Yechiel Leiter, accuses The New York Times of pushing a "blood libel" against Israel.

He compared the paper's Gaza coverage to the demonization of Jews in Europe before the Holocaust.

Mystery over the Russian military jet that landed at Ben Gurion on Sunday night.

Israeli media say it is still unclear who flew in on the sanctioned Defense Ministry Tu 154 from Chkalovsky air base near Moscow. The IDF and Russia's embassy are silent.
An Israeli Air Force Boeing 767 flying under the callsign DEXTER was tracked circling over the eastern Mediterranean off northern Sinai, flight tracking data shows.

UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash says talks with Tehran after the war are a strategic necessity, not a concession.

Any new dialogue must respect sovereignty, non interference and the security of Iran's neighbors, he says. Iran will remain a neighbor.

🚨 Iran has offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt attacks on Gulf shipping in exchange for the release of $8 billion in frozen funds, Israel Hayom reports.

President Trump is expected to discuss the offer with Qatar's prime minister today.

A US Air Force RQ 4 Global Hawk long range reconnaissance drone is flying east over the Mediterranean under the callsign RICO28.

It is expected to land at Naval Air Station Sigonella in Sicily.

🚨 Flights are steering clear of Jeddah airport in Saudi Arabia, with inbound aircraft avoiding landing at King Abdulaziz International.

No official reason has been given yet.

🚨 Iran's President Pezeshkian says Tehran wants dialogue and negotiation with the United States.

If Iran can secure its rights through talks rather than a war with America, "that would be the best outcome," he said.

🚨 Syria will join the Mecca Pact, the Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani defense alliance formed as Houthi attacks escalated, Syrian officials told AP.

Damascus has sent military advisers, and about 600 special forces are due near the Yemen border.

Iran is tightening security at home as the threat of a wider wave of US strikes grows.

Authorities warn protesters of tough sentences, break up youth gatherings in Tehran and run pro government booths offering Basij volunteers gun training.
Several US military helicopters were spotted patrolling the southern corridor of the Strait of Hormuz this morning.
Hacked records from Russia's Federal State Statistics Service reportedly show that 400,000 Russians have died in the war with Ukraine over the past five years.
🚨 Ukraine's General Staff says its forces have struck a Russian plant producing missile fuel near St. Petersburg.

🚨 Turkish President Erdogan says he passed Turkey's concerns directly to President Trump during their phone call.

Ankara does not want to see a new round of attacks on Iran.

🚨 Several explosions have been heard in the Strait of Hormuz.

They were likely caused by anti ship cruise missile launches by the IRGC Navy.

🚨 The Kremlin says only Russian, Ukrainian and American delegations will take part in this week's Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi, with no European officials at the table.

The claim contradicts a statement from France's Foreign Minister.

🚨 President Trump says he is not looking to escalate the war with Iran now that the midterms are over, and sees no reason to.

Asked about Iran's remaining nuclear material, he said: "They have nothing. It's buried under thousands of tons of rock."

🚨 Fuel exports from southern Iran have stalled at the Star Oil Refinery in Bandar Abbas.

Gas tanker drivers loaded for Pakistan via the Rimdan and Pishin borders cannot get exit permits or seals.

Footage shows long lines of parked tankers.
🚨 President Trump admits the US deportation policy was "too tough" following the Republicans' rout in the midterms.
